name: IKEA KNAGGLIG box, pine, 46x31x25 cm

sources.what: product page (article 702.923.59; W 46 x D 31 x H 25 cm; package 47x29x6 cm, 2.25 kg)

overallDimsMm.note: x=width (long side), y=depth, z=height; from the product page

parts.name: long side panel
parts.material: solid pine slats on two vertical battens (pre-assembled)
parts.notes: Three horizontal slats nailed/stapled to an upright batten at each end. Slat count from drawings; thickness estimated.

parts.name: bottom panel
parts.material: solid pine slats on two cross battens (pre-assembled)
parts.notes: Slatted floor; its battens' ends sit inside the long sides and take the long screws. Size estimated from overall dims.

parts.name: end board
parts.notes: Two plain boards per end, screwed across the ends of the side-panel battens. Size estimated.

parts.name: handle board
parts.notes: Top board at each end with the hand-hold notch. Size estimated.

hardware.size: long pan-head Phillips wood screw (IKEA 108363), approx 4x50 mm (estimated)
hardware.notes: Join the bottom panel to the long sides (2 per side: steps 2 and 4). Hand screwdriver only - instructions show no power drill.

hardware.size: short countersunk Phillips wood screw (IKEA 108560), approx 3.5x25 mm (estimated)
hardware.notes: Fix the end and handle boards: 8 + 4 per end (steps 5-8), 2 per board end.

joins.notes: Bottom slides into the side panel, then 2 long screws per side through the side batten into the bottom batten end.
Each plain end board bridges both side panels' battens: 2 screws at each end of the board (4 boards x 4 screws).
2 screws at each end of each handle board (2 boards x 4 screws).

assembly.stepsSource: official instructions AA-1159337-8, numbered steps 1-8 on pages 3-8 (page 2 = tools and parts list: 4x 108363, 24x 108560, Phillips screwdriver)
order: 1: slide bottom panel into first long side
3: second long side onto the bottom
5: two plain end boards on the first end (8 short screws)
6: handle board on the first end (4 short screws), turn box over
7: two plain end boards on the second end (8 short screws)
8: handle board on the second end (4 short screws)

confidence: high for overall dims (460x310x250), part count (2 sides + 1 bottom + 4 end boards + 2 handle boards = 9), hardware counts (4x 108363, 24x 108560) and the 8-step order - read from the IKEA page and instruction drawings; the screw totals reconcile with the per-step callouts (2+2 long, 8+4+8+4 short). low for individual board sizes and screw sizes (estimated).
notes: Chosen over the LACK wall shelf (30x26x5 cm, AA-200208-15), which is one pre-made part plus 2 hidden keyhole brackets and 2 not-included wall screws in 2 steps - too little assembly to test joints. KNAGGLIG has 9 parts, 28 screws of 2 sizes and a repeated end sub-assembly.
